summary.text: Allie Wolf is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 26B, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran from Spring Valley, she also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Wolf said in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey that she was born in Luverne and has spent most of her life in Spring Valley, which her family moved to when she was five.
She joined the U.S. Marine Corps in 2011 and trained as a cryptolinguist specializing in Afghan Pashto at the Defense Language Institute in Monterey, California.

Ballotpedia lists her education as associate degrees from the Defense Language Institute (2013) and Rochester Community and Technical College (2015) and a bachelor's degree from Winona State University, Rochester (2021).
She lives in Spring Valley with her husband and two children, according to the survey.

Wolf's 2024 survey named child care costs, protecting southeast Minnesota drinking water from nitrates and forever chemicals, and defending reproductive and LGBTQ+ rights, including passing a Minnesota Equal Rights Amendment, among her main messages.
She lost the 2024 general election for the seat, according to campaign finance records Ballotpedia cites.
